blocks.text: SDLC software banane ka ek organized (tarteeb wala) tareeqa hai jo yeh yaqeeni banata hai ke software quality standards poore kare aur theek kaam kare. Software developers aur engineers is ko software ke design, development aur testing mein rehnumai (guide) ke liye istemal karte hain. SDLC kai steps (qadmon) par mushtamil hai jo Figure 1.1 mein dikhaye gaye hain. Har step ke apne alag kaam aur maqsad hain.

blocks.alt: Chhe hare dabbe baen se daen seerhiyon ki tarah neeche utarte hain: Requirement, Analysis, Design, Coding/Implementation, Testing aur Maintenance, har ek par chhota nishan. Har dabbe se hara teer agle dabbe mein jata hai. Maintenance se ek lakeer neeche neeche wapas chalti hai aur har pichhle dabbe ke baen pehlu mein dakhil hoti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.1: System development life cycle ke marahil (kitab ki Figure 1.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Seedhe teer batate hain ke kaam ek marhale (stage) se agle marhale mein jata hai: Requirement, phir Analysis, Design, Coding, Testing aur aakhir mein Maintenance. Neeche wali lambi lakeer Maintenance se shuru hoti hai aur har pehle marhale mein wapas jati hai. Matlab software chalne ke baad koi nayi zaroorat ya ghalti saamne aaye to kisi bhi pichhle marhale par wapas ja kar tabdeeli (change) ki ja sakti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab aage in steps ko ek ek kar ke parhati hai: Requirement Gathering, Design, Development, Testing, Deployment aur Maintenance. Figure 1.1 mein Analysis ka step bhi alag dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Software developers SDLC kyun istemal karte hain?
blocks.explanation: SDLC ek organized tareeqa hai jo design, development aur testing ki step by step rehnumai karta hai, ta ke software quality standards poore kare aur theek kaam kare. Har step ke apne kaam aur maqsad hote hain.

items: SDLC: software banane ka organized tareeqa; quality aur theek kaam yaqeeni banata hai.
